conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: B surfaces the single incident to act on with a dedicated ACT NOW banner and keeps every decision-relevant value, including checkout worker queue capacity, visible without extra clicks. A hides the checkout worker capacity data (94% utilization, 12 min queue remaining) behind a panel that ships with capacityFailed:true by default, so none of A's captured evidence ever shows that decision input rendered. B's own demoed partial-failure region (image processing) is explicitly the noncritical one, which better matches the brief's stated priorities.

findings.label: A
findings.description: Checkout/search worker capacity (94% utilization, 12 min queue remaining, 63% search) is hidden behind a panel that defaults to a failed-load state and never renders successfully in any provided evidence.
findings.evidence: A/source/app.js:85 (capacityFailed: true); A/desktop.png, A/evidence/state-02, interaction-02, interaction-03 all show the same 'Capacity data failed to load' message.

findings.label: A
findings.description: A demoes its required 'partial data failure for a noncritical region' on the Capacity zone, but capacity data (queue minutes, utilization) is explicitly decision-relevant in the brief, making it a poor choice of 'noncritical.'
findings.evidence: scenario brief facts item 5 (checkout worker queue capacity); A/source/app.js:165,378-382.

findings.label: B
findings.description: Rollback and runbook dialogs declare role=dialog and aria-modal=true but the source shows no focus trap, no Escape handling, and no return-of-focus to the trigger button on close.
findings.evidence: grep for focus/trap/keydown/Escape in B/source/app.js returns no matches; contrast A/source/app.js:513,529,545,548 which implement trap and focus return.

findings.label: B
findings.description: aria-live="polite" is set on the whole #app container rather than a dedicated status region, so any re-render (range change, refresh) re-announces full page content to screen readers instead of just the changed status.
findings.evidence: B/source/index.html:10; contrast A's dedicated #live-region at A/source/app.js:174.

findings.label: A
findings.description: The three-zone equal-weight layout (Needs Attention / Selected Incident / Capacity) has no single dominant element signaling the one incident to act on, relying on scanning a colored list row instead of a top-level call-out.
findings.evidence: A/desktop.png — no banner-level visual priority comparable to B's ACT NOW block.
